source.revision_policy: Every repository and download URL is bound to the observed 40-hex commit SHA.
source.file_identity_policy: LFS/Xet files retain upstream SHA-256; Git files retain blob SHA-1 and are verified with the canonical Git blob header after download.
source.license_policy: Metadata is provenance only. Download and use remain subject to each repository license and access policy.

tiers.micro: Explicit TFLite Micro/TinyML/MCU evidence, or a <=16 MiB-per-TFLite MCU candidate. Candidate status is not a memory-fit proof.
tiers.mid: Standalone TFLite/ONNX or other per-model runtime artifact without large-model evidence.
tiers.large: LLM/VLM/generative runtime, large-model container, shard evidence, or >=1 GiB repository model payload.

download_policy: Metadata snapshot is tracked; model bytes remain in the user-local cache and are never deployed.
